in 15 stores across Arkansas, Georgia, Louisiana, and Texas and online at Academy.com in early October. With men's, women's and kids' styles available, including the Arahi 9, Challenger 8, Clifton 11, Rincon 5, and Torrent 5, Academy is fueling fun for the whole family.

"At Academy Sports + Outdoors, our gear is designed to support athletes across all skills and experience levels. With the addition of Hoka, we are both building out our premium running assortment and offering customers more great footwear styles to wear in their everyday lives," said Matt McCabe, Executive Vice President and Chief Merchandising Officer. "Our organizations have a shared ethos – to make a positive impact through accessibility to sports, the outdoors, and general wellness and we're excited for our customers to be able to pick up everything they need for their next warm-up, race, or cool down jog."
Academy offers a strong assortment from many top brands including Brooks, Nike, adidas, ASICS, New Balance, Puma, and OOFOS.
To learn more about Academy Sports + Outdoors visit Academy.com.

Academy is a leading full-line sporting goods and outdoor recreation retailer in the United States. Originally founded in 1938 as a family business in Texas, Academy has grown to more than 300 stores across 21 states and counting. Academy's mission is to provide "Fun for All" and Academy fulfills this mission with a localized merchandising strategy and value proposition that strongly connects with a broad range of consumers. Academy's product assortment focuses on key categories of outdoor, apparel, sports & recreation and footwear through both leading national brands and a portfolio of private label brands. For more information, visit www.academy.com.
